name: The Existence Of Ghosts
overview: Scripture reveals that while all things, visible and invisible, including spiritual powers and principalities, were created by Christ and are under His authority, human souls are distinct and guarded by God who alone can destroy both soul and body in hell. The resurrection of Jesus demonstrates that death has been overcome and the soul is not held by death. Believers must recognize that their true battle is not against flesh and blood but against spiritual wickedness, affirming that any notion of ghosts must be understood within the reality of spiritual forces rather than human spirits lingering after death.
